Same defect as a `{{…}}` placeholder in an example, but invisible on the wire because the copied text looks plausible. An `example` is the strongest prompt a protocol has: whatever it contains is what a small model will send. Make the values obviously stand-ins, or generic enough that copying them is visibly wrong.
